breadcrumbs.title: Womens wetsuit NeilPryde Spark Fullsuit 5/4 BZ Black

description: Spark has always been one of NeilPryde's most successful and best-selling women's wetsuits. Known for its exceptional flexibility and insulation in its price category. Comfort has been enhanced with super soft Nam Liong neoprene, the mesh panel has been replaced with a double lining and extended with internal thermal insulation covering the entire upper body. This means greater flexibility, superior comfort and thermal protection at the highest level. Spark exceeds its price class by delivering a wetsuit that meets high standards without breaking the bank. The NeilPryde Spark product line is designed for women who want to impress with style and beauty, even on the water, with a model created for experienced female surfers whose priority is comfort and freedom when surfing, even in the most demanding conditions.
features: GBS Seams - Glued and blind stitched for a watertight seam
Apex Light - Flexible, wind cutting Apex Light outer layer over the shoulders for extra flexibility and wind-cutting warmth.
Armortex Light Kneepads - Highly durable, abrasion-resistant fabric with 4-way stretch around the knees for added protection
E3 Velcro Attachment - Highly durable, abrasion resistant 4-way stretch material around the knees for more protection.
E3 Entry System - Easy entry and a watertight seal in back zip versions
Detachable Ankle Cinches - Velcro straps to keep legs in place when using in waves
Aquavents - To release water from the body in front zip versions and from the legs in all long leg versions
Fireline Light - Soft, comfortable and flexible inner lining to keep your core body temperature warm without restricting movement.
Nam Liong neoprene - One of the highest quality and most flexible neoprenes used in any wetsuit in this price range

product_highlights.text: You should make your decision on which wetsuit to choose, taking into account the time of year and the water temperature. In the case of this model, 5/4 mm thick neoprene is used, which means that it provides comfort in cold waters of 6-12° C
product_highlights.title: Wetsuit thickness 5/4 mm

product_highlights.text: If you're looking for ease and speed in getting your wetsuit on, this model is perfect for you. The long zipper at the back makes it much easier to both get into the wetsuit and take it off. Attach the strap from the zipper to the Velcro strap so that it does not interfere with your session.
product_highlights.title: Zipper on the back

product_highlights.text: The neoprene material used in the production and the technologies applied make this wetsuit model characterized by exceptional flexibility. As a result, it adapts perfectly to the body and guarantees full freedom of movement
product_highlights.title: Flexibility

product_highlights.text: The wetsuit is designed for durability during extreme adventures on the water. The construction and materials used are extremely durable, guaranteeing long-lasting use
product_highlights.title: Robustness

short_description: The women's wetsuit suit from NeilPryde Spark 5/4 Fullsuit GBS Back Zip features the E3 Entry system , which allows for easier entry and a more comfortable fit than any version with a front zip. The comfortable temperature of this suit is between 6°C and 12°C.
